---
title: "check-language-suffix-names.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that flags a name ending in a language suffix,
such as `fit_py = model.fit(X, y)` or `fit_r <- lm(y ~ x)`,
bound in a code chunk.
A page that shows one step in R, Python, and Julia
gives each language's object the same name,
so the tabs read as one example,
and each language keeps its own namespace.
The rule comes from Morrison-Lab/lds#3152.

## Where it applies

The check reads:

- every executable `{r}`, `{python}`, and `{julia}` chunk
  of a `.qmd`, `.Rmd`, or `.md` file;
- a whole `.R`, `.py`, or `.jl` script, when `globs` names one.

A plain `r` fence, shown as text, is not read.

## What it flags

A name ending in one of `suffixes` (default `_py _r _jl`)
that a line binds:

- an assignment target: `x_py = 1`, `x_r <- 1`, `a_py, b = f()`,
  `x_py: int = 1`, `x_py += 1`, or `const x_jl = 1`;
- the target of R's right assignment, `f() -> x_r`;
- a loop variable: `for x_py in xs`, `for (i_r in xs)`,
  or `for i_jl = 1:n`;
- a definition: `def f_py(`, `class A_py`, `function f_jl(`,
  or Julia's short form `f_jl(x) = ...`;
- a Python `as` target: `import numpy as np_py`
  or `with open(p) as f_py`;
- a walrus target: `(n_py := len(x))`.

The check does not flag:

- a use of an existing name, such as `print(x_py)`;
- an assignment to an element, such as `x_py[0] = 1`;
- an assignment to an attribute, such as `obj.x_py = 1`;
- a keyword argument, such as `f(n_py = 1)`;
- a name inside a string or a comment;
- a name that is only a suffix, such as `_py`;
- a line carrying, or following a comment-only line that carries,
  `# check-language-suffix-names: allow: <reason>`.
  The reason is required.

## Scope

Only lines a pull request adds are reported,
so existing pages never block.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed
(a shallow clone, an unresolvable ref),
the check skips with a warning.
It never falls back to a whole-tree scan.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file in full on purpose.

Every run prints how many lines and files it examined.

## Limitations

- A string that spans lines can hide or invent a binding.
- A target list that spans lines, such as `(a,` then `b_py) = f()`,
  is missed, since each line is read alone.
- A brand new untracked file is invisible to `git diff`.
  Stage it to have a local run examine it.

## Inputs

| Input            | Type    | Default | Description |
| ---------------- | ------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `globs`          | string  | `'*.qmd *.Rmd *.md'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `suffixes`       | string  | `'_py _r _jl'` | Space- or comma-separated name suffixes that mark a language. |
| `paths-ignore`   | string  | `''`    | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`           | boolean | `true`  | Fail the workflow when a suffixed name is found. Set `false` to warn only. |
| `whole-tree`     | boolean | `false` | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string  | `'3.x'` | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository, because [a public repository's pull requests can run arbitrary code on it](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-language-suffix-names.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags a name ending in a language suffix (_py, _r, _jl),
# such as `fit_py = model.fit(X, y)`, bound in a {python}, {r}, or {julia}
# chunk on lines a PR adds. A Python object takes the same name as its R
# counterpart, since each language keeps its own namespace.
# Blocks by default; existing pages never block, since only added lines count.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check language-suffixed names

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-language-suffix-names.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd *.md'                     # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   suffixes: '_py _r _jl'                  # suffixes that mark a language
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'    # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: false                             # warn instead of block (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                        # scan every line, not just a PR's additions
    #   runs-on: private-runner                # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See
[`examples/check-language-suffix-names.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-language-suffix-names.yml)
for the full caller stub.
